segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin report smaller-looking pores and say oily areas stay oil-free longer after use.
segments.dry: One reviewer with skin that dries in some areas found the peel left it feeling clean and hydrated rather than aggravated.
segments.combination: A reviewer with combination and sensitive skin found it perfect for her mix of dryness, acne and melasma-prone areas.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin overwhelmingly report no irritation, redness or burning even when hesitant beforehand, though one reviewer with sensitive skin experienced itchy, red cheeks the next morning and another notes it could sensitize skin unused to exfoliants.
segments.mature: Reviewers in their late 30s to 80s report smoother, softer skin and some fine-line softening, with one 86-year-old finding it gentle enough to leave on 10 minutes with no tingle.

concerns.aging: Reviewers report smoother fine lines, a more youthful look and reduced appearance of sun damage/wrinkles with continued use; one reviewer felt results were not immediate despite hoping to target aging without retinol.
concerns.dehydration: Reviewers describe skin as hydrated, soft and not dry after use, with one specifically noting it doesn't cause flaky skin.
concerns.redness: Several reviewers note reduced redness or no redness at all after use, but one reviewer reports itchy, red cheeks the morning after first use and another says her face is red afterward (though she doesn't mind it).
concerns.barrier: Reviewers describe the peel as gentle with no burning or discomfort even with daily use, though a few note a tingling or stinging sensation, especially on damp skin or open pores.
concerns.spots: Reviewers report lighter-looking melasma and sun damage and more even skin tone overall.
concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers report reduced breakouts, fewer whiteheads and clearer pores, including with hormonal acne; one reviewer states clearly it does not make her break out, while a different product (not this one) caused a breakout in one photo-review; no reviewer reports the peel itself causing cystic acne.
concerns.oiliness: One reviewer with oily skin reports oily areas stay oil-free for longer after use.

Dermalogica is one of my favorite skincare brands and I was so excited to try a sample or their Liquid Peelfoliant. This is a daily peel, with ablend of acids and enzymes. I have sensitive skin, but didn't notice any irritation or issues with the peel. I do think it is pretty gentle, which also means the results are not crazy obvious. I noticed some brightening, but would need to use it more to see more results. Gifted by Dermalogica

I just finished my first bottle of this, and it has completely changed my skin. I have hormonal acne and since I've been using this (about 3 months) it's almost non existent. it can tingle a little bit but I've only found it to be when my skin is damp or my sores are wide open from a hot shower. It says to leave it on for a minute every other day I think, but I wear it for longer periods of time (5ish minutes) 1-2 a week.

I've always struggled with even skin tone/texure and blemishes. With consistent use (approximately a month or so), the Liquid Peelfoliant has helped my skin tremendously! My face is smoother and I see less breakouts than I used to. This product can be irritating at first, so you should start slowly with it. I'm up to using it every day now and have seen a HUGE difference in my skin!
I really like the way this helps my skin to look clearer and healthy. I have oily skin consequently my pores are rather large. This really make a difference.

My skin is combinations and sensitive, I have melisma and acne prone skin, it also dries in some areas. This liquid peel is perfect for me. I can leave it on and makes my skin feel clean and fresh. I think it has help keep melisma lighter.

This might just have eclipsed Daily Microfoliant as my favorite exfoliating product to smooth and clear my pores! My skin is much smoother after use and it has helped with the deep clogged pores along my jawline and whiteheads on my nose. I have sun damage on my cheekbones that seems to be a bit lighter already. I will definitely continue to incorporate into my skincare routine and would love to see a refill option.
